semiconductor_relevance: High — ISAC RESEARCH specializes in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) technology, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ISAC RESEARCH focuses on providing advanced ALD equipment and coating services essential for the production of semiconductors, solar cells, displays, and LED packages. They also offer customized R&D and process development services to meet specific manufacturing needs.
capabilities: ALD process development for R&D and manufacturing
